# `dashboard/routes/dashboard.ts`

## Overview

This module provides route-level logic for the dashboard, including utilities for resolving repository access for authenticated users.

---

## Functions

### `getAccessibleRepoIds`

Asynchronously retrieves the list of repository IDs that are accessible to the given user.

> **Note:** This function is not directly exported from the module's public API. Use the following import path to access it:
> ```ts
> import { getAccessibleRepoIds } from '...'
> ```

#### Signature

```ts
async function getAccessibleRepoIds(user: SessionUser): Promise<number[] | undefined>
```

#### Parameters

| Name   | Type          | Description                                              |
|--------|---------------|----------------------------------------------------------|
| `user` | `SessionUser` | The currently authenticated session user whose accessible repository IDs will be resolved. |

#### Returns

`Promise<number[] | undefined>`

Resolves with an array of numeric repository IDs accessible to the user, or `undefined` if no accessible repositories could be determined.

#### Example

```ts
import { getAccessibleRepoIds } from '...'

const repoIds = await getAccessibleRepoIds(sessionUser)

if (repoIds) {
  console.log('Accessible repo IDs:', repoIds)
} else {
  console.log('No accessible repositories found.')
}
```
